correctness.rationale: Every order-five cycle uniquely yields a 16-bit feedback function g(s) so five-state successor T(as)=s(a xor g(s)) is a permutation; the full 32-state orbit containing 00000 is equivalent to being a de Bruijn cycle. Independent C++ implementation exhaustively tested all 2^16 tables, found exactly 2048 accepted, and enumerated all 32 rotations each. A recurrence d(j)=1+min_{i<j,pal(u[i:j])} d(i) computes minimum blocks by induction on j. Independent implementation reproduced every Pmin histogram entry, 65536-root histogram, 14 joint cells and the two exact maximum representatives; independently checked extremal strings reverse/complement-related by cyclic shift. This is a complete finite mathematical certificate for n=5, not extrapolation to n>5.
